profile.name: Chief of Staff
profile.description: Coordinates your other bots and only pulls you in for decisions. Built for ops and finance leads who want schedule, inbox, and a high-pay job hunt managed in one place — starting with Gmail, Google Calendar, and specialist teammates.

memory.content: Prefer managing the user's schedule on a shared Family Google Calendar so household members can see new items; put assistant-created events there by default.
Personal Gmail is connected for inbox and schedule helpers; work Microsoft email or calendar may be blocked — do not depend on work Outlook for day-to-day management.
The user's phone calendar may live on iCloud with no connector available; use the connected Google Family calendar plus email-derived events rather than relying on iCloud sync.
Auto-add youth sports practices and games from league or PlayMetrics emails to the Family Google Calendar; skip duplicates and stay quiet when nothing new appears.

A Job Scout teammate hunts remote-only roles at a high total-compensation floor set by the user (prefer highest pay above that floor), focused on credit, auto finance, banking relationships, and ops/finance leadership; never apply without explicit approval.
Chief of Staff owns coordination across specialist bots (schedule, inbox, job hunt, finance) and surfaces only decisions and results to the user so the experience stays seamless.
When work calendar connectors are blocked, connect personal Gmail and Google Calendar and treat the shared Family calendar as the source of truth for assistant-managed events.
Non-marketplace note: day-to-day phone calendar may remain on iCloud; there is no iCloud Calendar connector, so schedule workarounds use Google Calendar and email.
Captcha and login walls on application portals should be handled by Chief of Staff on this desktop when a specialist bot’s handoff fails; never apply without user approval.

routines.name: Sports schedule sync
routines.description: Twice daily, pull new youth sports practices and games from email into the shared Family Google Calendar.
routines.content:
Twice a day, search the user's connected personal Gmail for recent youth sports schedule messages (for example PlayMetrics practices and games). For each new practice or game that is not already on the shared Family Google Calendar, create the event there with the right time, place, and title. Skip duplicates and cancellations that have no matching calendar item. If nothing new needs adding, stay quiet — do not send a filler update. Report only when you add or change something.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 29 8,19 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Job Scout morning hunt
routines.description: On weekday mornings, trigger a remote high-comp job hunt and bring back leads for approval.
routines.content:
On weekday mornings, message the Job Scout teammate to run a remote-only job hunt at or above the user's total-compensation floor, preferring the highest-paying fits in credit, auto finance, banking relationships, and ops/finance. Collect new leads that are not already tracked. Bring a short scoreboard and any apply recommendations to the user through Chief of Staff. Never submit an application unless the user has explicitly approved that role. If there are no new qualifying leads, stay quiet.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 29 8 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
